text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Daring Heart's Make Debut had 
finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: L! O! V! E!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Looking hot! Our glorious leader! The one 
taking the win is none other than Daring 
Heart~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lying in wait at the racetrack was... the 
Daring Heart Cheering Squad, dazzling 
enough to make your eyes blink.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thanks for all the great cheering♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd come all the way to Kyoto 
for me! I'm truly happy!"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's Heart's Make a Debut! There's 
no way I'm not going!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Matcha ice cream is super 
yum-yum, after all ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, fight, fight, Heart-chan! Silky 
smooth and shiny bright, Heart-chan!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora. A slightly 
high-maintenance, adorable roommate of 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees, it's the genius Pandora-chan~ I'll 
probably debut sometime next year~, 
maybe~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Btw Heart-chan, heard you totally crushed 
your race! C'mon, show meee how cool you 
were♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
All right, leave it to me! I'll be 
expecting plenty of loud cheers during the 
race♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after changing, Daring Heart calmly 
went through her routine. Her confidence 
and sheer nerve never cease to amaze.
choice_data_list:
(Am I the only one whose heart is 
pounding...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've tuned myself up thoroughly in time 
for today. I have confidence in that, 
but... a race has many uncertainties, and 
a mountain of things to consider.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Your brow is all furrowed. ...Did you eat 
a sour pickle or something?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. You really are a worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next moment, my nose was lightly 
pinched.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just hold your head high and stand your 
ground with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When I get back— make sure you greet me 
with a face that says, "I knew you'd win, 
baby."♪
